semantic_meaning: Collapses a complex network into a single controlling node to communicate concentration of leverage.
when_to_use: After showing a dense dependency graph to reveal the effective controller
When summarizing multiple moving parts into one bottleneck
When bridging from structure to leverage
when_not_to_use: If the narrative does not justify a single controlling node
If it implies certainty where the source confidence is low
As a transition effect without explanatory meaning

animation_behavior.description: Many nodes shrink/fade into one node; routes converge; the survivor node gets amber pivot marker.

input_parameters.name: node_ids
input_parameters.description: IDs of nodes participating in collapse.

input_parameters.name: target_node_id
input_parameters.description: ID of the final controlling node.

input_parameters.name: converge_point
input_parameters.description: Optional explicit converge point (defaults to target node center).

state_beats.label: collapse
state_beats.meaningful_change: Non-target nodes fade/scale down; edges compress.

state_beats.label: single_node_lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Target node remains; amber pivot marker locks.

expected_outputs: A reduced diagram with a single emphasized controlling node
validation_notes: Must not over-claim: use only when the sources justify the concentration.
